title: Comments for private functions should be avoided.
summary: Prefer giving the function an expressive name. Split it up in smaller, self-explaining functions if necessary. It is in the comments rule set. detekt does not run it by default.

title: Private properties should be named in a self-explanatory manner without the need for a comment.
summary: It is in the comments rule set. detekt does not run it by default.

title: Down-casting immutable collection types is breaking the collection contract.
summary: It is in the standard-library rule set. detekt does not run it by default. It needs type resolution.

title: Using var with mutable collections or values leads to double mutability.
summary: Consider using val or immutable collection or value types. It is in the standard-library rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.21.0. It needs type resolution.

title: Expression with two or more calls of operator not could be simplified.
summary: It is in the style rule set. detekt does not run it by default. It needs type resolution.

title: Double negative from a function name expressed in the negative (like takeUnless) with a lambda block that also contains negation.
summary: This is more readable when rewritten using a positive form of the function (like takeIf). It is in the style rule set. detekt does not run it by default.
